dashboard.label: TA-rapl Overview
dashboard.description: Collects power telemetry from /sys/class/powercap (RAPL energy counters in microjoules, package/core domain limits) and, as a fallback, from hwmon power sensors (/sys/class/hwmon

search.query: index=main sourcetype="rapl:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="rapl.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="rapl:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
